question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Banter
solution:
The correct answer is: **Repartee.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Banter** means the playful and friendly exchange of teasing remarks.

 
 
• **Example -** *There was much good-natured **banter**.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Repartee** means conversation or speech characterized by quick, witty comments or replies.
 
 
• **Example -** *The **repartee** between the two actors made the movie really funny.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that** 'Banter'** and **'Repartee'** are similar in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rebuke** means an expression of sharp disapproval or criticism.
 
• **Reliance** means dependence on or trust in someone or something.
 
• **Commendation** means formal or official praise.
